Her worried plush face is visible in three-quarter profile with a tiny bead of sweat, same low ponytail, light blue shirt, dark gray blazer and silver necklace. Action: the index finger descends slowly toward the confirmation area, stops just before contact, and trembles slightly. End: it remains hovering without pressing. Motion is extremely small and precise. Preserve the exact first-frame composition, character identity, outfit, props, and room. The camera stays locked and stable. No dialogue or lip movement.
